statement.p: Find the equation of a plane that is perpendicular to the vector 4\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}-5\,\mathit{\vec k} and passing through the point (-4,-2,5).

static.solution: 4\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}-5\,\mathit{\vec k} and passes through the point (-4,-2,5), an equation for the plane is (4\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}-5\,\mathit{\vec k})\cdot (\left(x-\left(-4\right)\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+\left(y-\left(-2\right)\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+\left(z-5\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}) = 0, or 4\mathopen{}\left(x-\left(-4\right)\right)+1\mathopen{}\left(y-\left(-2\right)\right)+\left(-5\right)\mathopen{}\left(z-5\right) = 0.
